realized.title: 12 Oct issue vs meter load
realized.summary: Battery_Data.xlsx carries the same house-load measurement as the lifetime workbook. The column is load_p_load_total (watts). It matches TotalConsumptionPower on the overlapping rows, and continues through 29 Oct. Deviation is actual load minus the 12 Oct issued p50. TL-2362 matches the previous meter on 3480 hours (correlation 0.994). KA-1608 matches the previous meter on 2693 hours (correlation 1.000).
